_comment: The Burrow: a hollow in the rock of Murk Hollow the Wayfarer can claim and hang trophies in. Read by scripts/core/Burrow.gd. A trophy is earned when its flag is set or its record reaches min. Stay away squatter_days days or more and a squatter has slept here: it leaves a rude note (squatter_notes) and rent_coins as a welcome-back gift. Trophies are never taken.

trophies.name: Cinder Seal
trophies.text: A scorched seal from the Cinder Rift. Still warm. Still angry.

trophies.name: Tide Seal
trophies.text: A seal from the Tidewater Rift. It drips on the carpet.

trophies.name: Mist Seal
trophies.text: A seal from the Mist Rift. Half of it is missing, or hiding.

trophies.name: Mended Veydal
trophies.text: A map of Veydal with every Rift crossed out in red ink.

trophies.name: Black Veil
trophies.text: Won at a Wake. Nobody cried harder than your Spirling.

trophies.name: Grudge Jar
trophies.text: A jar of names. Your Spirlings wrote them. Some are yours.

squatter_notes: A note on your pillow: "Lumpy bed. Ghastly trophies. Left rent. Do not come back early."
A note on the wall: "Your seals glared at me all night. Here is rent. I am not sorry."
A note in the soup pot: "Ate your soup. It was bad. Rent enclosed as an apology to my stomach."
rent_line: The squatter left %d coins of rent. How rude. How generous.
